summary: I approach problems through the lens of psychology, with a curiosity for what technology can make possible. My work has taken me from developing psychological assessments and conducting research to building digital systems and introducing AI into existing workflows. I enjoy turning complex problems into practical solutions, learning across disciplines, and finding ways to make knowledge more useful and enjoyable beyond its original context.

experience.title: MRC Indonesia
context: Project: Digital Survey Development and CSR Education Assistance Evaluation
Client: PT Gading Gadjah Mada | October–November 2026
bullets: Built and implemented a web-based survey application with AI assistance to support the evaluation of beneficiaries under the company's CSR education assistance programme, integrating questionnaire responses, housing photographs, data review, and Google Sheets.
Guided enumerators in using the application, resolved field-user issues, and revised the system throughout implementation.
Checked and analysed data for 215 education assistance beneficiaries across 34 villages, from 222 initial targets; applied documented eligibility criteria to produce scores and review notes.
Prepared evaluation reports and presented findings with the team to CSR representatives and company leadership to inform eligibility decisions and assistance priorities for the 2026–2027 programme.
Adapted the application for a second survey, retaining the instrument and preparing new target records for collection.

experience.title: Dinas Psikologi TNI Angkatan Darat
bullets: Developed blueprints, item specifications, and approximately 1,800 items across six cognitive subtests using AI-assisted Automatic Item Generation (AIG).
Reviewed and revised solution rules, answer keys, distractors, and visual presentation; coordinated requirements and review with the assigned Army officer.
Documented the development process and co-authored a module explaining AIG concepts, procedures, and item review.
Delivered a workshop for personnel at Dinas Psikologi TNI Angkatan Darat on the theoretical foundations and practical development of cognitive items using AI.

experience.title: Research Assistant — Universitas Padjadjaran
bullets: Supported research design, survey procedures, recruitment, field data collection, and preparation of ethics review materials.
Worked on the adaptation and measurement evaluation of four psychological instruments; conducted statistical analyses using R and structural equation modelling.
Prepared analytical reports, technical documentation, and manuscripts to communicate methods and findings.
Independently developed R scripts and an integrated analytical workflow for the Ecolit study involving 704 participants.
Automated analysis and report generation, created data visualisations, and published analytical outputs through a web-based research report.

experience.title: Executive Coordinator — Muria Research Center
bullets: Coordinated around 15 team members and made decisions on organisational activities, research schedules, and field implementation.
Coordinated research projects directly with environmental agencies (DLH), NGOs, and the Natural Resources Conservation Agency (BKSDA).
Supervised field researchers, developed research protocols and instruments, and contributed to data analysis, reports, and scientific publications.

experience.title: Field Research Assistant — SurveyMETER
context: Worker and Household Enterprise Survey, Southwest Papua | 2023
bullets: Conducted structured interviews and field observations, checking the completeness and consistency of quantitative and qualitative survey data.
